verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a managed realtime infrastructure service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an SLA, uptime commitment, or status page. The retry and outage-concern items are about other subjects and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
